svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print lying on its side (a 37 mm side face on the bed), so the clip

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bends along its layers and the largest span is 11.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tray: 42 high, 37 wide, 13 deep, walls 1.5, open on the lid side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clip: a 2 mm bridge over the counter top and a 1.5 mm finger

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 18 mm long, both curved to the heel counter (32 mm radius

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inside). Fitted gap 3.8 mm; 2.8 mm as printed (1 mm grip).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round every edge of the finger to 0.5 mm: it rests on the heel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tail slot 10 x 0.6 mm in the shoe-side wall, just under the roof.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: USB-C notch 9.4 mm wide in the bottom wall, open to the lid side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four bosses 4 mm round, 5 mm deep, in the corners, 1.6 mm pilot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the finger springs back after a 1 mm push; the slot passes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the tail; an M2 screw starts in each boss by hand.
